weakness: Administrator accounts without phishing-resistant MFA: text-message codes on email and property management; no MFA on the storage system and laundry platform
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(01)); P03 PR.AA-03; P01 R-001, R-015
remediation_plan: Authenticator-app MFA on every administrator account; hardware security key on email and banking with a spare in the sealed envelope; bank app-based token
milestones: 2026-09-15 app-based MFA on all seven services and the bank; 2026-09-30 hardware keys registered
resources_required: Two hardware keys about $100 once; owner time 2 hours

weakness: Reused password across two LLC systems; browser-saved passwords; installer default password on the gate controller; shared PIN unchanged after a departure
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; change the gate password with the installer; individual POS PINs; written rules in POL-01 7.3
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and reused password changed; 2026-09-30 gate password changed and PINs individual
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; installer visit about $120

weakness: Storage manager's mailbox and storage account and the shared Laundry mailbox without MFA
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(02)); P03 PR.AA-03; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA for the manager; give each attendant an account with delegated access to the Laundry mailbox and remove its password sign-in
milestones: 2026-09-30 MFA on and shared password retired
resources_required: Two additional suite licenses about $150 a year

weakness: No account list, procedures, or reviews; a former employee's account stayed active for six months; shared credentials; bookkeeper access beyond need
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives); P03 PR.AA-05, GV.RR-04; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Hire and departure checklist (POL-01 7.4); account list in POL-01 Appendix A; quarterly review of every system; bookkeeper role reduced; close the former payroll account
milestones: 2026-07-30 former assistant's account disabled (done); 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 bookkeeper role reduced and first quarterly review

weakness: Storage office desktop not encrypted and opens with no sign-in
source: P07 assessment (SC-28); P03 PR.DS-01; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Individual standard account with a password and screen lock for the manager; turn on the built-in disk encryption; recovery key in the sealed envelope

weakness: No backup of suite mail and files; no exports from LLC systems; no copy outside the tenant
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a., c., d.[03]); P03 PR.DS-11; P01 R-008
remediation_plan: Backup service for suite mail and files; monthly exports of the accounting, storage, and property management data to an encrypted drive kept at the home office; first restore test
milestones: 2026-10-15 backup service running; 2026-10-31 first exports and restore test recorded
resources_required: Backup service about $150 a year; encrypted drive about $80 once

weakness: No vendor requirements, list, or monitoring; bookkeeper has no written terms and held the company administrator role in all four files
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 GV.SC-04, GV.SC-05; P01 R-011
remediation_plan: Vendor list with notice contacts (POL-01 Appendix A); confidentiality and security terms with the bookkeeper; remove the bookkeeper's administrator role; ask the storage and property management vendors for their SOC 2 reports
milestones: 2026-08-12 bookkeeper administrator role removed (done); 2026-10-31 terms signed and vendor list complete
resources_required: Business attorney about $300 for the bookkeeper terms

weakness: Sign-in logs, mailbox rules, and user activity never reviewed
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 DE.CM-03; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day (POL-01 7.7) with a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident or alert; security alerts also sent to the phone

weakness: No reporting duty for staff or contractors and no list of whom to notify for each LLC
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 RS.CO-02; P01 R-012
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and four-entity notice map; post the call-the-owner notice at both sites; brief staff and the bookkeeper
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted (done); 2026-09-30 contacts printed, notices posted, walkthrough with the IT technician
